test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate active form of the given sentence.**

Those who help themselves are helped by God.

options.text: God helps those who help themselves.
Help yourself and God will help you.
God is helping those who are helping others.
If you help yourself, God will help you.

solution:
The correct answer is: **God helps those who help themselves.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **subject **of the **Passive Voice** is changed into the **object **of the **Active voice**. Also, the **object **of the **Passive Voice** is changed into the **subject** of the** Active Voice**.
 
• The given sentence is in the passive form and in the Simple Present tense.
 
• The Simple Present in the passive voice has the following form: **Object+ is/am/are+ V3+ by + subject**__
 
• The Simple Present in the active voice has the following form: **__Subject + V1+s/es+ object__**
 __
 
• Passive: *Plants are grown by them.*
 
• Active: *They grow plants.*
 
 
 
• An **auxiliary verb** is always used in Passive sentences.

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

​Correct Active Voice:__ *God helps those who help themselves.*
